args.message: San Francisco grew revenue fastest from 2024 to 2025: about 310%, from $224,935 to $921,757. Chicago was close behind at about 283%. Brooklyn grew about 6.8% and Philadelphia about 3.9%. Revenue here means pre-tax sales (subtotal converted from cents to dollars), which is the saved definition of revenue. Los Angeles and New Orleans are left out because they had no sales in 2024. San Francisco and Chicago had lower 2024 sales, which is likely why their growth is so high; check their opening dates if you need growth for stores open both full years.
